instruction: My new name is Sarah. Could you help me update the Chrome profile username to Sarah?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome profile name to 'Sarah'. Uses existing get_profile_name getter and exact_match metric. Same complexity as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_profile_name extracts Chrome profile name from Preferences JSON file at the correct path (profile.name)
Metric logic is correct: exact_match performs appropriate exact string comparison for profile name verification
Expected value is correct: 'Sarah' matches the instruction requirement exactly
Postconfig is appropriate and necessary: Chrome restart (pkill + relaunch + sleep) ensures Preferences file is flushed to disk and can be read
Complete coverage: The single requirement (update profile name to Sarah) is fully verified by the evaluator
Practical feasibility: Getter can access Preferences file via env.controller.get_file(), profile name will be available after user completes task
